questions.question: What bug does this MR fix?
questions.answer: Cursor pagination over events could drop events and mishandle the last page. The cursor only held created_at with a strict greater-than filter, so events sharing a timestamp across a page boundary were skipped, and the next cursor was returned whenever a page was full, even if it was the last page.
must_mention: events with the same timestamp are skipped
full last page produced a cursor

questions.question: What is the main thing to scrutinize in this fix?
questions.answer: That the ordering and the cursor comparison use the same keys: the query now orders by created_at, id and filters with a row comparison (created_at, id) > (cursor time, cursor id), so every event is returned exactly once.

questions.question: What happens when the final page contains exactly `limit` events?
questions.answer: The query asks for limit + 1 rows; only limit are returned and nextCursor is null when no extra row exists, so a last page that is exactly full no longer yields a cursor pointing to an empty page.

questions.question: Where is the fix located?
questions.answer: In listEvents in src/lib/pagination.ts (SQL and nextCursor logic) and the Cursor type, encodeCursor and decodeCursor in src/lib/cursor.ts, with specs in src/lib/pagination.spec.ts.

questions.question: What compatibility question should a reviewer raise?
questions.answer: Cursors issued before the change contain only createdAt; decodeCursor gives them an empty id, so the resumed page restarts at the beginning of that timestamp and can repeat an event already seen (duplicate rather than skip). A reviewer should ask whether that is acceptable for in-flight cursors.

questions.question: Which tests does this MR add or change, what scenarios do they cover, and what important case is untested?
questions.answer: The MR changes src/lib/pagination.spec.ts: the fake DB now filters and sorts on (createdAt, id), and two tests are added. One checks that a last page that is exactly full has nextCursor null; the other pages through four events sharing one timestamp with limit 2 and checks none are dropped (a, b, c, d). Untested: decoding an old cursor without id (the backward-compat path in decodeCursor), and the real SQL row-comparison, since the DB is faked.
must_mention: new test: exactly-full last page returns null nextCursor
new test: events with identical timestamps are not dropped across pages
old cursor without id (decodeCursor fallback) is untested

questions.question: List the files this MR changes in a meaningful way and say in a few words what changed in each.
questions.answer: src/lib/cursor.ts: Cursor gains id field; decodeCursor accepts old cursors without id, defaulting to empty string; src/lib/pagination.ts: query orders and filters by (created_at, id) tuple, fetches limit+1 rows, nextCursor only when an extra row exists and includes id; src/lib/pagination.spec.ts: fake DB updated for (createdAt, id) ordering; adds full-last-page and same-timestamp tests

src/lib/pagination.ts: query orders and filters by (created_at, id) tuple, fetches limit+1 rows, nextCursor only when an extra row exists and includes id
src/lib/pagination.spec.ts: fake DB updated for (createdAt, id) ordering; adds full-last-page and same-timestamp tests
